title: Topologically Charged Morris-Thorne-type Wormholes and the Energy Conditions
summary: In this paper, we investigate topologically charged Morris-Thorne-type traversable wormholes by solving the Einstein field equations with an anisotropic fluid as the energy-momentum tensor and analysing the resulting solutions. In continuation to the earlier work (Eur. Phys. J C {\bf 84} (2024) 1037), we consider the shape functions such as: (i) $A(r)=r_0\,e^{r_0-r}$; (ii) $A(r)=r_0\,a^r/a^{r_0}$,\quad $0 < a<1$; (iii) $A(r)=r_0\,\left(\frac{\cosh r_0}{\cosh r}\right)^δ$,\quad $δ\geq 1$; (iv) $A(r)=\frac{1}{r}+\ln\!\frac{r}{r_0}$; (v) $A(r)=B\,r^n+(1-B)$; (vi) $A(r)=r_0\,\frac{\mbox{ln}…
